adjudication.rationale: In packages/core/EventManager.ts, updateAllCalendarEvents now iterates `for (const reference of calendarReference)` and, when a matching in-memory credential isn’t found, performs `await prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: reference.credentialId } ... })` inside that loop. Because this `await` is inside a sequential loop, multiple calendar references will trigger multiple DB round-trips (classic N+1 pattern) and they are not parallelized/batched. This is a performance/scale concern introduced by the diff, not a correctness defect per se.
